name: agentwalletapi
description: Managed EVM and Solana wallets for AI agents: balances, transfers, swaps, approvals, governance policy checks, cross-chain bridges, Escrow (formerly Get Paid) checkout, Polymarket, and YieldWolf Casino. Backed by the OpenClawCash agent API.

agent_key.title: OpenClawCash agent API key
agent_key.description: Your OpenClawCash agent API key (starts with occ_). Create one at openclawcash.com under API Keys. It is stored by Claude Code, not in this plugin, and is only ever sent to openclawcash.com.
